theorems.name: Submission.gte_tangentProj_integrands
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (∀ x v : Amb n ℓ, ‖V.tangentProj x v‖ ≤ ‖v‖) ∧ (AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight → ∀ S : Set (Amb n ℓ), V.weight S < ⊤ → (∀ (e : Amb n ℓ) (g : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (C : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable g V.weight → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ C) → IntegrableOn (fun x => inner ℝ (V.tangentProj x e) (V.tangentProj x (g x))) S V.weight) ∧ ∀ T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), IntegrableOn (fun x => hsNormSq (V.tangentProj x - T.starProjection)) S V.weight)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
